149589: Xie Lian is the main protagonist of the Chinese web novel _Heaven Official's Blessing_. He was widely known throughout the Xian Le nation as the beloved yet strange prince.
149594: Hua Cheng is the deuteragonist and main love interest in Heaven Official's Blessing. One of the Four Great Calamities, Hua Cheng is the most famed of the three Devastation-class Demons in the Ghost World, thus he is entitled the Ghost King.
166979: Mu Qing is a supporting character in Heaven Official's Blessing. Mu Qing is a Martial God who oversees the southwest. Eight hundred years ago, he was the personal attendant of Xie Lian.
166980: Feng Xin is a supporting character in Heaven Official's Blessing. Feng Xin is a Martial God who oversees the southeast. Eight hundred years ago, he was the imperial bodyguard of Xie Lian and later, the first general of the Crown Prince's Palace Hall.
175354: He is one of the Five Elemental Masters in the Heavenly Court. Since he is often worshiped as a female version of himself and often transforms into a woman, he was given the nickname.
176990: Lingwen is the foremost Civil Goddess in the Heavenly Court and one of the notorious Three Tumors.
202401: She was the Imperial Preceptor of the fallen Banyue kingdom. She was claimed a traitor by its people after allowing the invading army into the city.
203677: Xiu Pei is a Heavenly Official of the Middle Court and subordinate of Ming Pei. He appears in the first arc of the story. He is a proud and composed young man. He takes his tasks as a Martial God seriously and isn't shown to be very emotional.
204394: Yi Ming is one of the Five Elemental Masters in the Heavenly Court.
220394: Pei Ming, titled as General Ming Guang, is the Martial God of the North with nine thousand temples dedicated to his palace. He is one of the Four Famous Tales: "The General Who Broke His Sword", as well as a member of The Three Tumors.
257181: A powerful female ghost of Savage rank and a former lover of Pei Ming.
261438: Qi Rong is a Savage level ghost who is close to becoming a Supreme. Despite not being a ghost of the highest rank, he is still regarded as one of the Four Great Calamities, known as the Night-Touring Green Lantern.
261439: He Xuan is a ghost of Supreme rank and one of the Four Great Calamities. He bears the title Black Water Submerging Boats and his domain is the Black Water Demon Lair.
279522: A Heavenly Official of the Middle Court and subordinate of Feng Xin. He often accompanied Xie Lian on his missions in the mortal realm alongside Fu Yao.
279523: A Heavenly Official of the Middle Court and subordinate of Mu Qing. He often accompanied Xie Lian on his missions in the mortal realm alongside Nan Feng.
281106: White No-Face, titled as the White-Clothed Calamity, is the eldest and most powerful of the Four Great Calamities. Centuries ago, he had great influence in the fall of the Xianle kingdom.
